Package de.labathome.trustconstr

Class NonlinearConstraint

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.NonlinearConstraint
All Implemented Interfaces:
Constraint, Jacobian
public class NonlinearConstraint extends Object implements Constraint, Jacobian
Nonlinear constraint of the form 
     lb <= fun(x) <= ub
Counterpart to scipy.optimize.NonlinearConstraint (scipy/optimize/_constraints.py:22).

fun is the constraint function R^n -> R^m, jac its Jacobian (R^n -> R^{m x n}). The optional hess callable is the constraint-Hessian-of-Lagrangian: hess(x, v) -> sum_i v[i] * H_{c_i}(x). When supplied, the orchestrator uses it to build the full Lagrangian Hessian H_objective(x) + hess(x, v); without it, the orchestrator falls back to the objective Hessian alone, which can hurt convergence on problems where constraint curvature matters at the optimum (e.g. Maratos).

Eq/ineq classification follows the same rule as LinearConstraint, including the two-sided interval split. Inequality rows are emitted in scipy's 4-block order (less, greater, interval-upper, interval-lower).
